name: Bharat Parenterals Ltd
title: Bharat Parenterals Ltd - 541096 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone BPL revenue fell 23% to INR 234 cr with utilisation at 48%/21%/24%, so supply is loose; FY27 guide of 10-15% growth rests on a INR 171 cr order book and two pending audits.

utilisation.quote: We are at 48% on the General, 21% on beta-lactam, and 24% on cephalosporins.

capex.quote: we don't need fresh capex to grow the standalone business by 10% to 15% next year.

triggers.label: Standalone utilisation 48% / 21% / 24%
triggers.quote: We are at 48% on the General, 21% on beta-lactam, and 24% on cephalosporins.

triggers.label: Standalone revenue down 23% to INR 234 cr
triggers.quote: the revenue for FY '26 stood at INR234 crores against INR 304 crores last year, a decline of about 23%.

triggers.label: Varenyam Bio commercial timeline pushed to Q4 FY29
triggers.quote: we are 3 months, at least one quarter running behind on schedule

triggers.label: Innoxel first positive EBITDA quarter INR 1.4 cr
triggers.quote: In Q4 FY '26, Innoxel turned EBITDA positive for the first time.

guidance.quote: we expect revenue growth of 10% to 15% with EBITDA margins in the same 10% to 15% range.
For Innoxel, we expect revenue growth of 35% to 45% with EBITDA margins of 20% to 25%.
For Varenyam Healthcare, we expect revenue growth of about 20% to 25% with EBITDA margins of 8% to 13%.
overall out-licensing income is expected between INR 70 crores to INR 90 crores.
commissioning of the facility in September of 2027

prior_guidance_check.metric: Standalone revenue growth 12% to 14% (prior call, per analyst)
prior_guidance_check.quote: the standalone business will grow by 12% to 14% on the top-line basis

prior_guidance_check.metric: Varenyam Healthcare FY27 top-line INR 75-80 cr (prior, per management recollection)
prior_guidance_check.quote: the guidance was always somewhere around INR 75 crores of top-line revenue, between INR 75 crores and an INR 80 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: Varenyam Bio commercialisation in FY27 (prior call, per analyst)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are 3 months, at least one quarter running behind on schedule

red_flags.label: Standalone revenue down 23%; guidance cut and missed
red_flags.quote: the revenue for FY '26 stood at INR234 crores against INR 304 crores last year, a decline of about 23%.

red_flags.label: Varenyam Bio timeline slipped one quarter or more
red_flags.quote: we are 3 months, at least one quarter running behind on schedule

red_flags.label: Consolidated PAT lower; Innoxel PAT loss INR 43.4 cr
red_flags.quote: PAT loss to INR 43.4 crores from INR 67.9 crores last year.

evasions.topic: Standalone growth base and recovery path
evasions.quote: The base business, we are expecting partial recovery this year.

evasions.topic: Innoxel CDMO revenue share by FY28
evasions.quote: The total number is something that I will not be able to give at this moment
